 IMD Weather Today: Cyclone Arnab Puts Andhra Pradesh And Odisha On High Alert; Check State-Wise Forecast And Safety Advisories
 By Aishwarya Samant Last Updated: Oct 26, 2026, 07:37 IST IMD Weather Today: Cyclone Arnab is expected to approach the Andhra Pradesh coast on October 28, bringing heavy rainfall and strong winds. Check IMD alerts, affected states and safety advisories.
 IMD Weather Today: Cyclone Arnab Puts Andhra Pradesh And Odisha On High Alert; Check State-Wise Forecast And Safety Advisories 
 IMD Weather Today: It is Monday, and a small break from all the festivities until the Diwali holidays arrive. While everyone must be running to schools, colleges and universities, it is important for you to check the weather in your area. 
 India is in a transitional weather phase from now onwards. The mornings are becoming misty in the north, giving a sign of winter's arrival. Meanwhile, the India Meteorological Department (IMD) has warned about a developing weather system over the Bay of Bengal. 
 The cyclone in the Bay of Bengal is expected to intensify into a very severe cyclonic storm before approaching the Andhra Pradesh coast on October 28, 2026. 
 This cyclone, named ARNAB, has prompted heightened preparedness along the eastern coastline of India. 
 The weather department has predicted heavy to extremely heavy rainfall in coastal Andhra Pradesh and Odisha. The warnings also include strong winds and potential flooding. 
 Parts of Tamil Nadu, Kerala and neighbouring inland states may also receive rain. Meanwhile, Delhi-NCR is expected to experience largely clear and warm weather today. 
 IMD Weather Forecast: Cyclone Map 
 IMD Weather Forecast For Costallines  
 Weather Today In Andhra Pradesh: Coastal Districts Face Heavy Rain and Strong Winds 
 Coastal Andhra Pradesh will be the most affected area in the cyclone warning. It is expected to face heavy to extremely heavy rainfall as the developing cyclone approaches. 
 There are warnings and concerns about flooding, waterlogging and damage caused by strong winds between Bapatla and Visakhapatnam. 
 Residents should monitor IMD advisories and follow local safety instructions. 
 Weather Today In Odisha: Heavy Rainfall Warning and Emergency Preparedness 
 The other affected area will be Odisha, expected to experience heavy to very heavy rainfall as the cyclone approaches the eastern coast. 
 Ganjam, Gajapati, Koraput, Rayagada and Malkangiri are under a red warning. 
 Residents should follow district-specific advisories regarding flooding, travel disruptions, school closures and evacuation arrangements. 
 Weather Today In Yanam, Telangana and Other Areas That May Be Affected 
 Yanam : May experience heavy rainfall and strong winds due to its proximity to the forecast landfall zone. 
 Telangana : Could receive rainfall and thunderstorms as the system moves inland. 
 Central and Eastern India : Parts of these regions may experience rain and thunderstorms. 
 Tamil Nadu and Kerala : May receive additional rainfall associated with the active northeast monsoon.
